decision.calibrated_ev_note: Under the frozen decision calibration (cfb_decision_calibration_v1, for edgedesk_cfb_v2.1.0) the calibrated EV never reaches the policy minimum: its highest value is -3.2% at any price, so no quote can be a certified bet today.

operations.rule: the worst section decides; UNKNOWN is never reported as OK

sources.what: the EdgeDesk Read: price-specific reads, frozen read snapshots and their grades (append-only)
the EdgeDesk EV engine: calibrated, robust, price-specific EV; frozen EV snapshots and their grades (append-only)

rule: One bettor-facing decision per game from lib/edgedesk_decision.js (the unified football decision engine), on the same model, quotes and evaluation as the quote-level EV. Layer A decides whether the wager can be evaluated (NO DECISION only for missing or invalid essential data, with blocker codes); Layer B decides BET / LEAN / WATCH / PASS at the exact price. Research status is never a decision; a BET needs the edge and EV thresholds on the decision probability, and its stake is capped by the probability source.

shadow: stake caps by probability source until live validation improves
validation.note: The thresholds and stake tiers are conservative, configurable defaults, not empirically validated yet; the per-tier record below is how they will be.

alternatives.note: BEST CURRENT PRICE is the best book for the exact line evaluated. BEST PLAYABLE ALTERNATE is a nearby line (within 3 pts, odds -300 to +300) on the same side that also clears the BET threshold; SAFER ALTERNATE is a nearby lower-variance line that keeps positive EV. An extreme longshot or ultra-safe alternate is never offered, and the biggest raw EV is not automatically the best wager.

caps.text: The starting quarterback is unresolved, and the price only qualifies if the projection survives confirmation. (home (COMPETITION); Georgia: contested quarterback job (unresolved: Gunner Stockton 94% of recent dropbacks and Ryan Puglisi 6% of recent dropbacks — sources disagree.))

warnings.text: Decision thresholds and stake tiers are conservative defaults, not yet validated on live results; the live record and CLV sample are still accumulating. Research, never a guarantee.
PARTIALLY CALIBRATED: temperature (SHADOW) is validated out of sample, not on live results; the stake is capped at 0.5U.
A quarterback situation is contested.
Availability data is incomplete.
Only one fresh book prices both sides of this number.
The edge triggered price verification; every check cleared, and the stake is capped.
Sportsbook stake limits are not published to EdgeDesk; the edge is quoted per unit.

bet_trigger.text: Georgia becomes BET at Georgia -8 (-105) or Georgia -10.5 (+117) or better, if the rest of the market stays where it is.
bet_trigger.caveat: If the whole market moves to that number, the calibrated probability moves with it; EdgeDesk re-evaluates automatically.

alternatives.note: BEST CURRENT PRICE is the best book for the exact line evaluated. BEST PLAYABLE ALTERNATE is a nearby line (within 3 pts, odds -300 to +300) on the same side that also clears the BET threshold; SAFER ALTERNATE is a nearby lower-variance line that keeps positive EV. An extreme longshot or ultra-safe alternate is never offered, and the biggest raw EV is not automatically the best wager.

checks.text: the quote belongs to this game and these teams
home/away orientation of the quote
a gap that vanishes when the market sign is flipped is a sign fault
the evaluated quote is inside the freshness limit (0 min old)
the quote sits within 1.5 pts of the consensus (0.0 away)
the alternate ladder is monotone
only one book prices this side: nothing to compare with
the books agree within 1.5 pts
both sides of one number cannot both be good bets
no market integrity fault
this book’s number sits with the rest of the market
a large gap has passed the research integrity gate (or none was required)
model–market gap inside the CFB outlier band (10 pts)

best_execution.reason: Georgia -10.5 (-105) at draftkings is the only verified quote on this side worth executing.
best_execution.rule: Executable = verified price, fresh quote, validated tail, book on the market. Ranked by the decision engine’s own objective: decision class, then EV per unit of return volatility (line value, juice and key-number protection are already inside the EV).

ladder.summary: At -105: -10.5 PASS (now) · -10 WATCH | At -10.5: -105 PASS (now) · +100 WATCH
